## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): description`); it becomes the squash commit on `main`.
- [ ] Every commit is signed and shows as **Verified** on GitHub.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for the change.
- [ ] Security impact considered: which trust boundaries this touches (signer, CA keys, audit log, trust bundles, authentication, host agents), and why the change is safe.
